title: Nicolas Raince to Montmorency, Rome, 13 May and 20 Nov 1526, BnF fr. 2984 pp. 29-31 and p. 105

steps.what: Tomokiyo's keys, DECODE records, Mignet 1886 and Bourrilly 1901 located; unread residue isolated to pp. 29-31 and p. 105.
Tomokiyo's key table read by eye; l, m, n shifted one column.
Blind cluster-to-letter solver in session 1 collapses to a degenerate map.
Key re-measured programmatically off the image; control line resolves glyph for glyph.
Shape-constrained hill-climb over 70/140 clusters with a 6-gram LM gives draft5, about 86 % of letters right.
86 of 106 lines read glyph by glyph against numbered-token images; 20 lines left with a machine decode only.
Old fraction_read checked: it counted resolved characters, not sense. measure_sense.py (period-French lexicon, ?/(?)/word signs unread) gives 0.476 on trans/reading.txt.

All 106 lines re-read off fresh Gallica images via numbered-token crops (trans/reading_v3.txt), including the 20 machine-only lines; sense rises to 0.850 (p.29 0.92, p.30 0.86, p.31 0.85, p.105 0.75). Residual single glyphs do not resolve on the microfilm.

Second pass on the 13 worst lines with contrast/unsharp/threshold zooms (zoomx.py): circled cross identified as an i homophone, -| as o; ℓ° found to be a word sign not in the key; sense 0.850 -> 0.870.

Pastor IX (archive.org historyofpopesfr09past) app. 38 prints Raince 26 Nov 1526 (f.109): parallel wording ('habandonner et s'enfuyr', 'du coste de dela') confirms p.105 readings, but it is a different letter. Grethen 1887 not found digitised.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): raince_cipher.txt (segmented token ids) and gold/labels.txt; readings trans/reading_v3.txt (latest), trans/reading_edited.txt and the clear close trans/p31_clear_close.txt

Reading audit (George Lasry's test: can a reader build coherent sentences and translate them?). trans/reading_edited.txt and reading_v3.txt read: nearly every line of pp. 29, 30, 31 and 105 is broken by '…' or (?) ('… de la ca[pi]tulation faicte …', '… court … depuis …'); isolated clauses survive, the sentences cannot be assembled (docs/_check_reading.py: 28-41% of sentences clean). Relabelled decoded, not read; class read in part -> not read, method read with known key -> not solved (key kept as a part); fraction_read 0.87 -> 0.

Re-read (REREAD_BRIEF, batch b32): DECODE list searched for fr. 2984 / Raince (no record); Gallica IIIF manifest of fr. 2984 fetched: still the B/W microfilm, and its 39-item list names no decipherment or clear double of the 13 May or 20 Nov 1526 letters.

trans/residue1526_reading.md built from trans/reading_v3.txt (b32_raince_build.py: unresolved glyphs as [...], line-end breaks joined where the join is a word, 9 kept by hand); score 0.513 (59/115) plain, 0.713 on explicit holes; below the 0.60 bar on the plain figure and the look-alike share unmeasured, so kept decoded, not read.

Method restored: key obtained by Tomokiyo's 1526 key for the Raince letters, re-measured off his key image (read with known key); text not read, class stays not read. The 22-24 Oct reading audit had set the method to not solved because the class was not read; George Lasry (24 Oct 2026) separates the two.

outcome.method_basis: Tomokiyo's 1526 key for the Raince letters, re-measured off his key image and applied to a glyph-by-glyph transcription (read with known key, recorded under parts), decodes the 13 May and 20 Nov 1526 passages into clauses broken by unresolved stretches in nearly every line. Method restored 24 Oct 2026 (George Lasry: a key can be mostly recovered while the text is not read): the key was obtained by Tomokiyo's 1526 key for the Raince letters, re-measured off his key image; class stays not read, as the text does not read.
outcome.fraction_read_source: 22 Oct 2026, reading audit: the passages do not build sentences, so nothing counts as read (0). Withdrawn as a reading figure: 0.87, measure_sense.py on trans/reading_v3.txt (letters in period-French words over 5,265 non-null tokens), which counted letters in words, not sentences.
outcome.notes: All 106 lines hand-read from the images in session 3; fraction is sense-measured (old 0.66 counted characters). Limit is microfilm resolution.

texts.label: BnF fr. 2984 pp. 29-31 (13 May 1526) and p. 105 (20 Nov 1526)
texts.summary: The ciphered residue of two letters from Nicolas Raince in Rome to Anne de Montmorency, 13 May and 20 November 1526, about 106 lines unread anywhere found: news of the court, the Castilians and Burgundians after the capitulation, the Pope and the Emperor. Deciphered with Tomokiyo's 1526 key as re-measured here (CALIBRATION.md); reading_v3.txt is the latest line-by-line reading (unresolved glyphs marked ?), reading_edited.txt the earlier running French.
texts.note: Decoded, not read. Re-read 23 Oct 2026 (batch b32, trans/residue1526_reread_log.md): the 5 Oct glyph-by-glyph reading (trans/reading_v3.txt, not seen by the audit) set out as trans/residue1526_reading.md scores 0.513 (59/115) plain and 0.713 on explicit holes; p. 29 ll. 11-25, p. 31 and p. 105 ll. 1-8 hold, p. 30 and p. 105 ll. 9-21 have a hole in most sentences; the look-alike share of the microfilm's confusable glyphs is not recorded. No DECODE record, no print, no contemporary decipherment (Gallica item list checked); the only images are the B/W microfilm. Blocker: illegible.

parts.label: fr. 2984 pp. 29-31 and 105 (Tomokiyo 1526 key applied; decoded, not read)
parts.basis: Tomokiyo's 1526 key re-measured (CALIBRATION.md) on a glyph-by-glyph transcription of the microfilm; clauses broken by unresolved stretches in nearly every line. Decoded, not read (reading audit, 22 Oct 2026).

prior.where: Key published by Tomokiyo 2020 without plaintext; partial glosses on the leaves; other letters of the volume read by Mignet 1886 and Bourrilly 1901

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
